description: This file defines the API for inter-VM shared memory (ivshmem) in Zephyr OS, including function prototypes, macros, and data structures for managing shared memory regions, VM IDs, interrupt vectors, and peer communication.

methods.name: ivshmem_get_mem
methods.description: Retrieves the shared memory region for the device.

methods.name: ivshmem_get_vectors
methods.description: Returns the number of interrupt vectors available.

methods.name: ivshmem_register_handler
methods.description: Registers an interrupt handler for a specific vector.

methods.name: ivshmem_get_output_mem_section
methods.description: Gets the output memory section for a peer (ivshmem-v2).

methods.name: ivshmem_get_state
methods.description: Gets the state of a peer VM (ivshmem-v2).

methods.name: ivshmem_set_state
methods.description: Sets the state of the local VM (ivshmem-v2).

methods.name: ivshmem_get_max_peers
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of peers supported (ivshmem-v2).

methods.name: ivshmem_get_protocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol used by the ivshmem instance (ivshmem-v2).

methods.name: ivshmem_enable_interrupts
methods.description: Enables or disables interrupts for the VM (ivshmem-v2).
